title: [Performance][DSA] Use activation exchange for PCP decode O projection
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Replace O-weight AllGather with activation exchange for sharded decode in DeepSeek V4 and V4.1: token AllGather across PCP ranks, local O projection, then ReduceScatter.

Share batch-scoped O projection handling, allocate graph-stable buffers during initialization, and add unit coverage.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Optimizes sharded decode with PCP O projection weight sharding enabled.

### Decode performance

Three-round medians after warmup, measured on the same A3 node and 16 NPUs:

- MRV2, DP2 × TP1 × PCP8, EP, W4A8, INT8 Indexer, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`; decode request sharding and PCP O-weight sharding enabled. MTP, Prefix Cache, FlashComm, multistream and prefill/fused MC2 disabled.
- 32 input / 1024 output tokens, greedy decoding with `ignore_eos=true`; concurrency 1 routes to DP0, concurrency 8 sends four requests to each DP rank. `max_model_len=16384`, `max_num_seqs=96`, `max_num_batched_tokens=512`, block size 128, 8 GiB KV cache per NPU, `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`.
- Tested vLLM-Ascend `5c1a6aa3c` → `b503e9105`, with vLLM `ced6857afa` and benchmark `19018e9cc`. The measured candidate contains the activation-exchange optimization; this PR also includes buffer-capacity hardening and test updates.

| Model | Concurrency | Decode token/s, before → after | Throughput gain | TPOT ms, before → after | TPOT reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| DeepSeek V4 Flash | 1 | 18.296 → 28.010 | +53.09% | 54.673 → 35.717 | 34.67% |
| DeepSeek V4 Flash | 8 | 143.674 → 216.919 | +50.98% | 55.714 → 36.905 | 33.76% |
| DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | 1 | 20.028 → 32.749 | +63.52% | 49.951 → 30.551 | 38.84% |
| DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | 8 | 157.490 → 255.723 | +62.37% | 50.838 → 31.334 | 38.37% |

Decode throughput uses the common decode time window, excluding the first and last 32 tokens of each request. All formal performance requests succeeded with the required output length, no KV preemption, and confirmed FULL graph replay.

Engram was disabled for both V4.1 runs. Both also used the same compatibility fixes for SWA metadata and empty-rank FULL replay; those fixes are outside this PR.

### Accuracy (DeepSeek V4 Flash)

GPQA Diamond first 100 frozen questions, repeated three times on one service. Tested this PR at `67b8757f6`, with vLLM `8cc9aa5ad` and benchmark `19018e9cc`.

- A3, 8 NPUs, MRV2, DP1 × TP1 × PCP8, EP, W4A8, INT8 Indexer, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`; decode request and O-weight sharding enabled. MTP, Prefix Cache, FlashComm, multistream and prefill/fused MC2 disabled.
- `max_model_len=65536`, `max_num_seqs=96`, `max_num_batched_tokens=8192`, 16 GiB KV cache per NPU; CLI block size 128 (model-resolved block size 8). `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` and `HCCL_BUFFSIZE_EP` both 1024.
- Non-streaming, concurrency 8, one worker, greedy decoding, seed 42, thinking disabled, `ignore_eos=false`, maximum 8192 output tokens. Identical prompts and option order across rounds; complete prompts passed through a `{prompt}` template.

| Round | Correct | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | 70/100 | 70% |
| 2 | 74/100 | 74% |
| 3 | 75/100 | 75% |

Mean: **73%**; range: **70%–75%**. All 300 requests succeeded with no timeouts; prompt hashes and native evaluator results were verified. All 8 ranks completed graph capture, and FULL replay was confirmed during each formal round.

Question 79 (zero-based) reached the output limit and yielded no extractable answer in every round; it was counted as incorrect, keeping the denominator at 100. Among the other 99 questions, 76 had the same extracted answer in all three rounds and 23 varied.

Historical single-round scores were 79% and 71%; the current mean differs by −6 and +2 percentage points. Those runs used another node, 16 NPUs with DP2, vLLM `ced6857afa`, and different sequence/batch/KV budgets (16384/512/8 GiB). They are historical references, not a matched before/after accuracy comparison.

### How was this patch tested?

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/8cc9aa5ad350f6f80cf3bebb298d410803ff75a9
